chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who performed the obligatory circumambulation (Tawaf) but did not know whether he had performed six or seven circuits. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Let him repeat his Tawaf.' I said: 'So he lost it?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'I do not see anything to be upon him, and the repetition is more beloved to me and superior.'

key_terms.فَاتَهُ: He lost it / It was missed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one is unsure whether they completed six or seven circuits of Tawaf?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the ruling for doubt in the number of circuits during the obligatory Tawaf, distinguishing between the validity of the act and the recommendation for perfection. He advises that while the pilgrim is not penalized for the uncertainty, repeating the Tawaf is preferred (*ahabb*) and superior (*afdal*), reflecting the Shia principle of *Ihtiyat* (precaution) in worship to ensure completeness. This ruling underscores the balance between legal ease and spiritual excellence in Hajj rituals.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin yahya, from Mansour Bin Hazim who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about a man who circumambulated the Obligatory Tawaaf, but he did not know whether he had circumambulated six (circuits) or seven. Heasws said: ‘So let him repeat his Tawaaf. I said, ‘So he lost it?’ Heasws said: ‘Iasws do not see anything to be upon him, and the repeating is more beloved to measws, and superior’.
en.sarwar: 1. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mansur ibn Hazim who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs an obligatory Tawaf but does not know if he has done six or seven Tawaf (walking around the House). He (the Imam) said, ‘He must do his Tawaf again.’ I asked, ‘Is that one lost?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘I do not see anything on him but repeating is more beloved and virtuous to me.’”
